title: kwangs player tracker
description: This plugin ads a item that you can craft that tracks players, the recipe is a netherite block surrounded by 8 compasses
body:
PlayerTracker is a simple Spigot plugin for Minecraft 1.21.x that lets players craft a special item to track other players in real time.

What it does

Players can craft a Player Tracker (a renamed compass) that points toward another online player. When held, an arrow appears in the action bar showing the direction of the tracked player. Right-clicking the tracker cycles through available players. Switching to another item instantly hides the arrow.

How to use

Craft the Player Tracker
Place a Netherite Block in the center of the crafting grid and Compasses in all other slots.

Start tracking
Hold the Player Tracker and right-click to select a player to track. Each right-click switches to the next online player.

Follow the arrow
While holding the tracker, an arrow appears in the action bar pointing toward the tracked player.

Stop tracking
Switch to any other item to hide the arrow.

Notes

If no other players are online, the tracker does nothing.

The arrow updates in real time.

Fully compatible with Spigot/Paper 1.21.x and Java 21.

Simple, lightweight, and perfect for survival, PvP, or manhunt-style gameplay.
